description: Zones d'effets du DIRI de Carrefour Supply Chain à Cholet dans le Maine-et-Loire is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.sigloire.fr. In accordance with circular DPPR/SEI2/FA-07-0066 of 4 May 2007, the Prefect informs mayors of technological risks around classified facilities for environmental protection (ICPE). This information consists of the definition of the zones of effect in the event of an accident on the industrial site and the limitations of urbanization. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Areas of effect of the DIRI of Carrefour Supply Chain in Cholet in Maine-et-Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
